name: graph-first-test-fqn-repoint
body:
Reconciliation (apg-cleanup, phase-02 spec-side follow-up): the durable `details` out-edge of `requirements.note.graph-first-test-pending` was re-pointed from the OLD code FQN `rust.apg.tests.e2e.graph_first_rule_stated_in_navigator_prompt_and_guide` to the relocated test's NEW FQN `rust.main_e2e.e2e.graph_first_rule_stated_in_navigator_prompt_and_guide` (path `tests/main_e2e.rs`, lines 1987-2115).

Source: the phase-02 plan text records a MANDATORY follow-up — phase-02 relocated the root crate's e2e tests onto `tests/*_e2e.rs` integration crates, so the `details` edge from `requirements.note.graph-first-test-pending` to the graph-first coherence test must be re-pointed to the test's new FQN, because `rust.apg.layers.validate_code_refs` validates only `implemented-by` targets (a stale `details` target is silent drift).

Inconsistency: the durable note file carried a `details` out-edge to the OLD code FQN, which the re-scan no longer produces. `apg_query` could not see it — `ingest.rs` drops any `Details` edge whose target node is absent (`g.nodes.contains_key(b)`), so the graph showed the note with only its `details` -> `requirements.requirement.graph-first-navigation` edge while the file still held the dangling one. Existence was determined empirically via `apg edge update` (which refuses when the out-edge is absent): update on the OLD target succeeded (edge present), update on the NEW target refused (edge absent) — so the recorded follow-up was real, NOT moot.

Resolution: `apg edge rm details requirements.note.graph-first-test-pending rust.apg.tests.e2e.graph_first_rule_stated_in_navigator_prompt_and_guide`, then `apg edge add details requirements.note.graph-first-test-pending rust.main_e2e.e2e.graph_first_rule_stated_in_navigator_prompt_and_guide`. The note's existing `details` -> `requirements.requirement.graph-first-navigation` edge is untouched. The re-pointed edge now resolves in the branch graph. [autonomous — the re-point was mandated by the recorded phase-02 follow-up; only the empirical existence check was required, no judgment call.]

Open item (not changed here, flagged for review): the body of `requirements.note.graph-first-test-pending` still names the OLD FQN in prose and cites its pre-relocation location (`src/main.rs:5147-5275`); the relocated test is now `tests/main_e2e.rs:1987-2115`. Fixing that prose is a separate reconciliation decision and was out of this follow-up's scope.
